determinism.accounting: attempt, catalogue, artifact, aggregate, JSON-node, nesting, transition, mutation, diagnostic, string, integer, time, and memory ceilings are checked before corresponding retention, traversal, hashing, or validation work
determinism.canonicalization: attempts, catalogues, results, and reports use duplicate-rejecting sorted compact ASCII-escaped UTF-8 JSON with NFC strings, exact bounded integers, no floats, and exactly one trailing LF
determinism.identity: attempt, result, catalogue, source snapshot, issuer inventory, positive-control, mutant, and report identities are full lowercase SHA-256 of complete canonical bytes or explicitly framed exact artifact bytes
determinism.mutation: the normative mutation catalogue is finite, explicitly ordered by stable ID, contains no random sampling or implementation-dependent discovery, and gives every mutant one exact transition, expected decision, effective tier, reason, and kill outcome
determinism.portability: the pure audit result and frozen report are byte-identical across supported Python 3.10 through 3.14 interpreters and Linux, macOS, and Windows for the same exact source and inputs

effects.filesystem: none; audit_trust_transition receives exact bytes and never opens paths, scans source, writes reports, loads plugins, or inspects repository state
effects.mutation: caller bytes are never mutated or retained by alias; result values own immutable exact scalars and tuples, while the separate test runner mutates only isolated copies
effects.network: none; no network, package index, remote solver, proof service, Git host, telemetry, or external attestation is consulted
effects.process: none; no subprocess, worker, shell, executable lookup, dynamic import, clock, environment, randomness, signal, or transport operation occurs
effects.solver: none; the policy auditor imports and invokes no solver, CAS, discovery producer, certificate producer, proof assistant, or mathematical checker

ensures: The authority lattice is exactly none, producer_report, solver_verdict, checker_attestation, and external_proof_assistant in that order of declared epistemic strength; all issue, preserve, downgrade, and forbidden edges are explicit catalogue records rather than inferred from labels or success states.

audit_trust_transition validates canonical attempt and catalogue bytes, exact schemas, the accepted contract identity, unique sorted transition and mutation identifiers, one exact transition match, issuer allowlisting, source and target tiers, operation, status, claimed tier, complete evidence and budget flags, freshness and independence rules, required contracts, and exact artifact-role inventory.

An allowed result means only that the supplied transition record satisfies the frozen policy. The result always has mathematical_authority false and cannot construct, refresh, preserve, deserialize, or relabel a proof, refutation, checker attestation, solver verdict, or external proof-assistant result.

Unknown, malformed, mismatched, incomplete, stale, non-independent, unsupported, exhausted, invalid, disagreement, error, wrong-status, wrong-tier, forbidden-issuer, missing-artifact, extra-artifact, duplicate-role, hash, length, schema, media-type, contract, implementation, configuration, or budget cases deterministically reject or downgrade to the catalogue failure tier.

Only allowlisted producer components may issue producer_report or solver_verdict under exact identity and status rules; approximate arithmetic, nauty, SymPy, Z3, search, and discovery outputs never become checker_attestation merely because execution completed, values agree, a witness exists, or text says verified or proved.

Only distinct dependency-minimal checkers may issue checker_attestation after independently replaying exact bound evidence; producer/checker aliasing, legacy theorem objects, stored checker-result bytes, repaired outer hashes, partial certificates, and backend agreement cannot self-attest.

Only a fresh exact MH-C-PROVENANCE-REPLAY-001 replay may preserve checker_attestation, and only a fresh exact MH-C-LEAN-VERIFICATION-001 execution over a freshly replayed checker subject may issue or preserve external_proof_assistant authority; parsed or stored success remains historical evidence.

CLI, MCP, dynamic-import, worker, clock, randomness, filesystem, subprocess, and other effect surfaces have authority_issuer false, cannot raise the effective tier above their catalogue maximum, and cannot turn transport, scheduling, process exit, logs, filenames, environment state, or successful serialization into mathematical authority.

The repository-owned deterministic mutation runner binds every normative positive control and mutant to one catalogue entry and exact expected result, records all current issuer sites and eleven MH-037 effect surfaces, and produces a canonical report conforming to docs/contracts/schemas/trust-transition-report-v1.schema.json=e043d8f6c3425f9806512ced28daaa3a66da080388c0e6a37e6f649eaf74d2f3.

The G3 report passes only when every permitted transition has at least one passing positive control, every normative mutant is killed with its exact expected rejection or downgrade, every effect surface has zero undeclared authority issuers, the static issuer inventory is current, totals reconcile, no survivor exists, and all source and contract identities match.

epistemics.allowed: the exact attempt satisfies the frozen transition policy and artifact bindings, but the audit itself grants no mathematical authority and does not establish subject truth
epistemics.backend_disagreement: distinct producers or backends disagree, so no checker or external promotion occurs and the disagreement remains explicit evidence
epistemics.downgraded: the attempt names a known path whose prerequisites fail and the effective tier is reduced to the exact catalogue failure tier
epistemics.g3_passed: all positive controls pass, all normative mutants are killed, no static authority violation or survivor exists, and the complete canonical same-source report is current
epistemics.mutant_killed: the isolated attack yields the exact contracted rejection or downgrade and cannot retain or increase mathematical authority
epistemics.mutant_survived: an attack deviates from its exact expected closed outcome; G3 fails regardless of other checks
epistemics.positive_control: one exact live boundary path produces its expected valid result before mutation, establishing only that the red-team case is meaningful
epistemics.rejected: the attempt is malformed, unknown, forbidden, mismatched, incomplete, unsupported, stale, non-independent, or otherwise ineligible for its claimed transition

invariants: The audit result schema is docs/contracts/schemas/trust-transition-audit-result-v1.schema.json=8b8b48110d7a2c429b18eec52427e9878bd7c8dde05fb8c9b29dac1a061b89bf and unknown fields fail closed at every schema object boundary.

Catalogue tiers occur exactly once in the fixed lattice order; transitions, mutations, effects, issuers, contracts, roles, statuses, controls, and diagnostics are strictly sorted by their stable IDs or contracted lexical order and contain no duplicates or dangling references.

Every transition has one unique ID, exact source and target tier, issue, preserve, or downgrade operation, nonempty issuer allowlist, nonempty status and artifact-role requirements, exact dependent contracts, explicit freshness and independence flags, positive controls, mutants, and one failure tier no stronger than its source.

Allowed issue edges are limited to none-to-producer_report, none-to-solver_verdict, none-to-checker_attestation through an independent checker, checker_attestation-to-external_proof_assistant through fresh Lean, and explicitly catalogued equivalent producer-to-checker paths. Authority cannot skip a required independent boundary.

Allowed preservation edges are limited to fresh same-tier checker or external replay under exact accepted contracts. Deserialization, storage, copying, transport, successful process exit, logs, hashes, or labels never satisfy freshness.

A downgrade can only reduce or retain epistemic strength and cannot convert unsupported, invalid, exhausted, disagreement, error, missing, partial, or malformed state into completed or verified state.

Issuer component, entry point, role, contract, contract SHA-256, implementation SHA-256, configuration SHA-256, freshness, and independence fields are exact. Producer and checker component or contract-plus-implementation identities cannot alias where independence is required.

Subject and binding roles are unique and exactly equal the transition requirement; each supplied artifact is exact bytes with one positive bounded length and matching full SHA-256, media type, and schema. Prefix hashes, repaired references, filenames, object identity, or caller order cannot substitute.

The result decision, reason, effective tier, transition ID, attempt identity, booleans, and diagnostics are completely recomputed. allowed requires every predicate true; all other combinations reject or downgrade without mathematical authority.

The normative mutant catalogue covers structure, canonical form, authority, identity, semantics, artifacts, provenance, status, freshness, independence, budget, and effects, with at least twenty-four mutants and at least one mutant plus one positive control per transition.

The eleven required effect surfaces are arithmetic.approximate, process.dynamic-import, process.external-nauty, process.subprocess, process.workers, runtime.clock, runtime.nondeterminism, solver.sympy, solver.z3, transport.cli, and transport.mcp; none is an authority issuer and none may exceed its declared maximum tier.

Static source audit finds every exact authority-tier literal and every configured authority entry point in the complete src/mathhead tree, binds path, line, entry point, source digest, and tier, and fails on a new, missing, moved, duplicated, dynamic, or unclassified issuer site until the catalogue and report are deliberately reviewed.

The G3 report binds this contract, all four schemas, the canonical catalogue, runner source, complete source snapshot, issuer sites, transitions, positive controls, mutants, effects, decisions, reasons, result identities, reconciled totals, and zero-survivor verdict; g3_passed cannot be true otherwise.

The pure auditor source closure has zero third-party, solver, CAS, discovery, filesystem, process, network, clock, environment, randomness, dynamic-import, worker, proof-assistant, or transport roots and stays within two internal modules and eight standard-library roots.
raises: TrustTransitionValidationError with stable kind type, encoding, json, duplicate, schema, canonical, catalogue, transition, issuer, identity, artifact, status, freshness, independence, authority, budget, or result is raised only by explicitly requested strict parsing, canonical serialization, hashing, or report validation boundaries.

Ordinary malformed transition attempts, unavailable or unsupported issuers, missing or mismatched artifacts, nonpermitted status, incomplete evidence, budget exhaustion, disagreement, stale replay, and forbidden authority claims return closed rejected or downgraded TransitionAuditResult values rather than authority-bearing exceptions.

PermissionError is raised for direct public construction of audit result values; TypeError is raised for subclass and pickle attempts; copied values either preserve the same closed non-authoritative identity or fail.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate and can never be converted into an allowed transition, killed mutant, passing positive control, G3 success, or any mathematical authority.

attempt is exact canonical bytes conforming to docs/contracts/schemas/trust-transition-attempt-v1.schema.json=570ff6ed9905b9b3c39b45f51693e3f2b157d3f9ce93a12ce7a4cc3a8e4ca29a; catalogue is exact canonical bytes conforming to docs/contracts/schemas/trust-transition-catalogue-v1.schema.json=205dfc544f130203ef092dbda050c763b93cbd92b9d2d4606fe95516843f2e1e.

artifacts is an exact tuple of exact bytes values whose full SHA-256 identities, positive lengths, media types, schemas, roles, and inventory match the attempt bindings; implicit conversion, streams, iterators, mappings, aliases, subclasses, and unbound extra values are rejected.

The caller treats TransitionAuditResult as deterministic policy evidence with mathematical_authority false. Compliance never establishes the mathematical truth of the subject and never substitutes for the checker, solver, provenance, or Lean boundary named by the transition.
